dataset: GJP Data doi:10.7910/DVN/BPCDH5 CC0 original ifps.csv
unit: one original IFP metadata row, NOT human forecast
pre_registered_endpoints: unique ifp_id count and duplicate IDs
controls: do not print question_text/short_title or individual rows
if q_type conditional question rows share ifp_id, report duplicates without deduplicating silently
date_closed timestamp may be missing for unresolved; classify not invalid blindly
interpretation: Feasibility of question-level availability calendar. Does NOT establish individual offer, actual display or randomized assignment; cannot label no forecast a personal failure.
output: Aggregates only, no human data or political scoring
